svg.title: Explain why a mailbox row needs review
svg.desc: A practice report uses storage readings to warn the team about full mailboxes. Read. Load the used amount and the limit for each box. Check. A missing reading or a zero limit needs review. Report. Keep all four rows visible, including the two needing review.
